# definednet Provider

Manage Defined Networking networks, roles, tags, routes, SSO domains, and endpoint OIDC providers through the [Defined Networking API](https://docs.defined.net/api/defined-networking-api/).

Create an API key at https://admin.defined.net/settings/api-keys with the scopes for the resources you manage (for example `roles:create`, `roles:read`, `roles:update`, `roles:delete`).

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    definednet = {
      source = "johnmaguire/definednet"
    }
  }
}

# api_key can also come from the DEFINEDNET_API_KEY environment variable.
provider "definednet" {
  api_key = var.definednet_api_key
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `api_key` (String, Sensitive) API key used as the bearer token. Falls back to the `DEFINEDNET_API_KEY` environment variable.
- `endpoint` (String) Base URL of the API. Falls back to the `DEFINEDNET_ENDPOINT` environment variable, then `https://api.defined.net`.
- `skip_credentials_validation` (Boolean) Skip the `GET /v2/whoami` check that verifies the API key when the provider is configured. Defaults to `false`.
